sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with Terre centered, a satellite at r; student
sets orbital speed v; if v = √(GM/r) circular orbit closes; else
ellipse or escape. HUD reads T = 2π√(r³/GM) (3rd law) and v.
Experiment: 3 seeded target periods T; student picks r so satellite
orbits at that period. Evaluate: orbit trace hidden; only Terre and
satellite dot shown; ticker runs full period; student submits r
blind. Wrinkle: closed-form circular is what's tested at 3ème depth
(no numerical Kepler integrator needed).
